articleTitle: CrowdAnalyzer Homepage Teardown: Jul 2016 to Jun 2026
h1: How CrowdAnalyzer rewrote its homepage over 10 years

analysis-blocks.label: Jul 2016 — original state
analysis-blocks.heading: The original: product-led messaging
annotations: H1 opens with: "The 1st Arabic Focused Internationally Recognized Social Media Monitoring Platform" — a direct product statement.

analysis-blocks.label: Jun 2026 — current state
analysis-blocks.heading: Today: updated positioning
annotations: H1 now reads: "Empowering Growth Through Data-Driven Insights" — updated value proposition.
New section headings include: "See our story​", "Get in touch", "Visit the newsroom​".
Navigation now includes product categories like: "Media Intelligence", "Advertisements Intelligence".
Third-party validation visible in section headings: "Gain valuable knowledge on emerging trends, analytics best practices, and success strategies to elevate your brand".
CTAs no longer present include: "Request a Demo", "Product Tour", "Login".

messaging.before: The 1st Arabic Focused Internationally Recognized Social Media Monitoring Platform
messaging.note: This change can be read as a deliberate update to the primary value proposition frame. No confirmed strategy is implied.
